question: If the co-ordinates of A and B are (4, 1) and (-2, 7) respectively, then the co-ordinates of the midpoint of AB are.

And, y = (y1 + y2)/2 = (1 + 7)/2 = 8/2 = 4
So, the coordinate (x, y) = (1, 4).

question: A man has 72 green marbles and 108 red marbles. He decides to pack them into packets of the same size, each containing either all red or all green marbles. What is the greatest number of marbles he can put in each packet?
explanation:
🔖72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3
108 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3
The highest common factor of 72 and 108 is 36. Therefore he can put 36 marbles at maximum in each packet.

question: Half of the student of a school play football and one third of the rest play cricket. The remaining 300 students do not play either of the games. How many students are there in the school?
explanation:
🔖Fraction of students playing Football = 1/2
Fraction of students playing Cricket = 1/3 of the remaining 1/2 = 1/6
Now, fraction of the students not playing either of the games = 1 - (1/2 + 1/6) = 1 - (3+1)/6 = 1/3
According to the question, 1/3 of the students = 300
So, the number of total students = 300 x 3 = 900.

question: Three-fourth petrol of a reservoir is used to fill the petrol tanks of five trucks having the same storage capacity. What part of the total capacity of the petrol reservoir did each truck receive?

Total capacity of five trucks = 5T
According to the question, 5T = 3/4 of R
or, T = 3/4 x R / 5 = (3/20) R
So, each truck received 3/20 of the reservoir.
